when_used: A cautioner withdraws a caution registered against a title, so that the entry is removed from the Encumbrances Section of the register.

detail_rows.label: Date of Instrument of Withdrawal of Caution:

body_text.text: The Cautioner HEREBY APPLIES to withdraw the Caution registered in Entry Number(s) {{entry_numbers}} on the Encumbrances Section of the Register.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this withdrawal of caution has been duly executed this........................…. day of……………………..20…………….

foot_notes: Give full names ID/Passport No.; PIN and Address

custom_fields.name: caution_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the Caution
custom_fields.prompt: The date of the caution being withdrawn

custom_fields.name: cautioner_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Cautioner
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the cautioner

custom_fields.name: proprietor_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the registered proprietor

custom_fields.name: proprietor_address
custom_fields.label: Address of the Proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Postal address of the registered proprietor

custom_fields.name: entry_numbers
custom_fields.label: Entry number of the Caution
custom_fields.prompt: The entry number or numbers of the caution in the Encumbrances Section of the register
